preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The parent list p must have n-1 elements, and each parent p_i must be less than i.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to partition the leaves, modulo 998244353.
